subject: GOBACK statement
notes: kb/Work/PB409.md landed w39. EC-FLOW-GLOBAL-GOBACK was a catalog row with no raise site and no TURN wiring; it now has all three - EcBinder.QueryFor's precise BoundGoback arm puts the name in the statement's enabled set, EcEmitter.FatalAmbientGates maps it to ExceptionState.FlowGlobalGobackChecking, and EmitGoback tests the GLOBAL declaratives' own __useActive slots. WITHIN THE RANGE is a RUN-TIME relation, so it is the dynamic activated-and-not-yet-returned flag 14.9.49.4 GR2 already maintains, never a bind-time approximation of SR1; SAME PROGRAM comes free because the array is per program instance and a container's GLOBAL declarative runs in the container's. Measured on legal source (a GOBACK in an ordinary paragraph a global declarative PERFORMs): checking ON terminates the run unit abnormally per 14.6.13.1.3 rule 7, checking OFF is lenient per 14.6.13.1.1. DETERMINATION: the Table 13 neighbour EC-FLOW-GLOBAL-EXIT gets NO raise site - 14.9.14.4 states no general rule that sets it (GR3 imports 14.9.18.4 GR3 and GR4, not GR6) and Table 13's third column is a description.
